proposals.title: Proposal 5. Shareholder Proposal Seeking a Simple Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests elimination of all supermajority voting requirements in charter and bylaws, replaced by a majority of votes cast standard.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote FOR it.

proposals.title: Proposal 6. Shareholder Proposal Seeking a Report on Integrating Community Impacts Into the Company's Executive Compensation Program
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a Compensation Committee report assessing feasibility of integrating community stakeholder concerns and impacts into executive compensation program.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.
